paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences, measured in thousands (K), across various categories within the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis, labeled “Categories,” lists the categories: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Sentences (K),” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 900, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 100 units. Each category is represented by a single, light-red colored bar with a numerical value displayed above it indicating the number of sentences in thousands. The shortest bar corresponds to “Blogs” with a value of 2, while the tallest bar represents “Administrative” with a value of 525. Other bar values are: Religion (50), Non-fiction (190), Fiction (35), Law (23), News (110), and Science (902). The bars are not sorted in any visually apparent manner, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
